authorization: 用户要求扩大固定容量／并发压力矩阵，分解工具波动并验证预测排序额外收益
live_scope: nested first3/6/10 known development parents; not independent final holdout
policy_selection: three complete Latin cyclic orderings by repeat; all cells; no tuning or best-capacity selection
generation_limit_note: new global fsynced ledger; hard maximum 3117 including 39 capacity gate probes; expected live1539, no automatic reruns
primary_metric: submit to independently validated correct final answer JCT; include observer, checks, prediction and scheduling; failures retained
fixed_ttl_semantics: 1-second soft priority at pressure, expiration permits LRU; never hard-blocks ready requests
runtime_transfer: Only statistical compatibility guard is mapped after the physical gate; native tensor cache identity stays new and distinct; same fixed model/tokenizer/context/F16

tool_timing: diagnostics only; NPZ materialize, operation compute/imports, process CPU, main-thread schedstat runqueue wait, proc IO/faults, checks and artifact fsync; never wall minus multithread CPU

admission_rule: all complete input blocks must fit capacity; no truncation or bypass
tool_cache_state: normal filesystem page cache; per-call integrity hashes warm inputs; no system-wide cache dropping
decision_audit: same-state shadow retired-first LRU, no future requests, diagnostics included for every policy
tool_timeout_scope: Existing semantics preserved: compute communicate deadline is call start+240 seconds; process group killed and reaped if exceeded. Blocking pre/post immutable input checks are not preempted; final tool wall can exceed240s. All checks retained and full wall included in JCT.
